comments.content: Critical Bug: Calling `.toString()` on `null` will throw a `TypeError: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'toString')`. A null/undefined check should be performed before accessing properties or methods on potentially null values.
Security Vulnerability (SQL Injection): Directly concatenating user input (`id`) into a SQL query string allows an attacker to inject arbitrary SQL. Use parameterized/prepared statements instead.
comments.suggestion_code:
const query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = ?";
  return db.execute(query, [id]);
comments.existing_code:
const query = "SELECT * FROM users WHERE id = " + id;
  return db.execute(query);

comments.content: Security Issue (Hardcoded Secret): API key is hardcoded in plain text in the source code. This exposes sensitive credentials in version control. Use environment variables or a secrets manager instead.
